name: Drywhisker Gorge
summary: Northeast of Hammerfall, Drywhisker kobolds hold a gorge in the eastern mountains of the Arathi Highlands. They guard its inner cavern, rich mineral deposits and ancient elemental relics buried underground.

sections.title: A Warren in the Eastern Crags
sections.body: Drywhisker kobolds hold the crags east of Hammerfall. Their clan has dug deep into the mountains and fiercely guards its winding passages. Below, they mine veins of Lesser Bloodstone Ore. Their stronghold lies close enough to trouble the orcs at Hammerfall.

sections.title: Secrets of the Deep Cavern
sections.body: Deep in the Drywhisker cavern lies a stone shard. The kobolds are allied with the towering stone giants of the highlands and tend motes of ancient earth magic. The shard holds a trapped fragment of Princess Myzrael's essence. She is an ancient earth entity bound below the surface.

faq.answer: The Drywhisker clan of kobolds lives in the gorge and its cavern passages. They defend their territory and mining operations, along with the relics hidden within.

aliases: how to get to drywhisker gorge
where is the cave in arathi
faq.answer: Drywhisker Gorge cuts through the eastern mountains of the Arathi Highlands, northeast of Hammerfall. A rugged path climbs through the hills east of the outpost to the cavern entrance.

faq.q: What makes the cave inside significant?
faq.answer: The cave holds rare deposits of Lesser Bloodstone Ore and an ancient stone shard. The shard contains a fragment of Princess Myzrael's imprisoned essence.

faq.q: Why are the kobolds allied with mountain giants?
faq.answer: The Drywhisker clan is allied with the local stone giants. The kobolds serve and guard earth relics and elemental motes tied to Princess Myzrael's bindings deep beneath Arathi.

angles.text: Miners prize the Drywhisker cavern as the only known source of Lesser Bloodstone Ore. The dense, crimson-veined mineral lies deep within the kobold-held rock.
The hostile Drywhisker kobolds live just over the mountain ridge east of Hammerfall. They threaten the outpost's eastern flank.
